reviews.title: Very Good Motherboard for 1851 Intel Chipset. Great Starter Motherboard for Gamers!
reviews.comment: I really wanted this motherboard for a gaming PC. Make sure that RAM is in there good. Very beginner friendly!!! This ATX Motherboard fits perfectly in my Vetroo AL900 Mid Tower Case. I plan to install a sound card and other devices and Having 3 extra PCIe slots is good. NO crashes yet. I have an I7 Processor with a 3060 12GB. You will get a DRAM error light on your Motherboard if you do not install Your RAM properly. The Slots are TIGHT so don't be afraid to apply pressure..
reviews.author: Darius

reviews.title: Great Msi motherboard!
reviews.comment: The MSI B860 Plus WiFi is a reliable and feature-packed motherboard designed for Intel’s latest processors, offering strong performance and excellent connectivity for gamers and PC builders alike. With built-in WiFi 6, PCIe Gen 4 support, and high-speed DDR5 compatibility, it delivers fast and stable performance for both gaming and productivity. Its durable design, efficient cooling solutions, and user-friendly BIOS make it a great choice for those seeking a solid, future-proof motherboard at an affordable price.
reviews.author: Garrhett Franko
